answer: The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in ferrous, expire in lantern, and canyon lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 180 aliases as a result needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 81 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
